payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the input image, is there visible progress toward closing the same woman's jacket, when corresponding evidence of its front closure can be compared?
node.criteria: Pass: comparable visible evidence shows the jacket has moved toward closure, but the edited jacket is not fully closed. Fail: comparable visible evidence establishes no progress toward closure. Unknown: pose, occlusion, drape, or other differences prevent a reliable comparison of the actual closure; an open-looking edited silhouette alone is not evidence of no progress.
node.binding: Compare the same woman's pink jacket in the source and edited images, focusing on corresponding visible evidence of the actual front closure. Count only progress toward closure, not unrelated edits; do not infer no progress from an uncomparable view.
